notes: MedallionHook: fee hook of the FARE447/ETH launch pool (v4-core 1.0.2, solc 0.8.26, cancun, optimizer 200, via_ir off). Permissions afterInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (0x10CC), validated in the constructor. Only constructor argument: the chain's PoolManager ($poolManager); all else public constants. afterInitialize never reverts; the first native-ETH pool initialized with the hook is launchPool and the only pool that pays fees, so the factory deploys the hook and initializes the pool in one transaction. DISCLOSURE: CREATOR 0x70c6C4fcaAb11151FCEDb32eaaC3431547193A0a is the requester's own wallet; the petition is fiction by the requester and the 1.64 ETH payout is intended. MEDALLION_NFT 0x9C8fF314C9Bc7F6e59A9d9225Fb22946427eDC03 is on mainnet the Nouns ERC-721, and Noun #447 is held by the Nouns DAO treasury timelock, not by CREATOR: retire() succeeds only after a passed Nouns DAO proposal approves the hook for Noun #447 or sends it to 0x...dEaD; until then the first 1.64 ETH of fees stays as claims with no other exit and may never be released. Fee: 2% of the ETH (currency0) side of every launch-pool swap, never in FARE447: positive specified BeforeSwapDelta for exact-in buys and exact-out sells (PartialFill if the pool fills less), positive unspecified afterSwap delta of 2% of the gross ETH delta otherwise. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims; swap callbacks make no other external call. Ledger: totalFees grows only through swaps; creatorEntitlement = min(1.64 ETH, totalFees); burnable = totalFees - entitlement - burnSpent; claims held >= totalFees - creatorPaid - burnSpent; Recouped once. retire(): permissionless, nonReentrant (transient lock, slot 1); NotRecouped / AlreadyRetired; ownerOf(447) by staticcall (MedallionUnavailable); unless already at DEAD, transferFrom(owner, DEAD, 447) with RetireRefused(returndata) on failure; then creatorPaid = 1.64 ETH, claims burned in its own unlock, ETH taken to CREATOR, MedallionRetired, CreatorPaid and LastFare emitted. Nothing else ever sends ETH to CREATOR. burnIMD(viaPool4, callerMinOut): permissionless, nonReentrant, own unlock, two fixed keys: POOL4 (ETH, IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, 10000, 60, hook 0xc6C965Bd164c483e87d0B550671798e9A3602840) and plain (ETH, IMD, 10000, 200, no hook). Order: TooSoon (5 blocks), Pool4Unavailable (fallback with viaPool4, or POOL4 never read), batch = min(burnable, 0.05 ETH normal / 0.01 fallback), NothingToBurn under 0.002 ETH, then reference and guards. Normal: POOL4 marketOpen() and refTick() answer; reference = refTick, also written to anchor, blockAnchor, lastRef. Fallback: plain pool only; reference = the anchor at the start of the block; the anchor then steps <= 200 ticks toward the plain spot clamped to lastRef +- 1000, once per block, also via permissionless pokeAnchor(); lastRef is written only from POOL4, never in fallback, so the band is fixed while POOL4 is silent: a plain-pool move held > 1150 ticks below lastRef stops burns until POOL4 answers, for good after a terminal close. One-sided guard: PriceOffReference only if spot < reference - tolerance (300 for plain in normal mode, else 150). minOut = max(96% of the quote at the reference, callerMinOut); PartialFill on zero/partial fill; all IMD to 0x...dEaD; the caller gets nothing. Burns need keepers; a sole LP of the plain pool can sell IMD to the hook up to ~3.9% below POOL4's reference per batch inside the fixed tolerances. On Sepolia retire(), burnIMD() and pokeAnchor() revert while fees accrue. status() returns the IN SERVICE / RECOUPED, NOT RETIRED / RETIRED sentence. No owner, admin, pause, upgrade, setter, sweep, dynamic LP fee, token fee, fee-on-transfer, tip or caller-chosen burn size; no SELFDESTRUCT, DELEGATECALL or CALLCODE. FareToken: self-contained ERC-20, 18 decimals, exactly 1e27 to msg.sender from a zero-arg constructor, burn/burnFrom only. initialPrice (1e7 FARE447 per ETH) is an assumption.
